title: A representable morphism is universally closed exactly when all its base changes are closed on spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises representable morphisms of algebraic stacks which are universally closed as those whose every base change induces a closed map on topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 2666-2678, label lemma-characterize-representable-universally-closed). The proof (source lines 2680-2703) proves the non-trivial direction by choosing a smooth scheme cover of the test stack, where the base change is closed by hypothesis, and descending closedness along the comparison square whose horizontal arrows are open and surjective and whose induced map to the fibre product of spaces is surjective (proof lines 2681-2701); the converse is recorded as following from the definitions. The descent along the comparison square is the content. H2.
